title: Lead Instrumentation & Controls Engineer 2 - Nuclear
description:
Overview

This I&C position offers the opportunity to work on upgrading and modernizing nuclear power plants with the latest control technologies the industry offers. You will be expected to both lead and support small and large controls projects with a focus on technical execution and effective Project Management. These projects will require coordination with mechanical, electrical, and structural disciplines to bring the project to completion. You work will include investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving a wide variety of controls engineering issues, including the following:

  • Develop Digital Systems Design -- PLC, DCS, HSI, networked computer systems.
  • Prepare control system functional and implementation requirements and procurement specifications for nuclear plant control systems.
  • Interface with the client to ensure proper project execution and client satisfaction.
  • Prepare and review technical reports, calculations, and studies to present information in a clear and concise manner to meet client requirements.
  • Manage resources/resource loading and develop estimates for task completion and budget development.
  • Support the development of proposals.
  • Prepare and review diagrams and drawings for new and upgraded controls solutions.
  • Evaluate vendor bids from a technical perspective.
  • Interface with vendors to perform document reviews, ensure equipment compliance with specifications and needs of the plant, and witness FAT performance on behalf of the client.
  • Support implementation of the project at the client’s facilities.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience

  • BS or MS in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Nuclear Engineering from an ABET accredited program.
  • 12 or more years of experience in the design engineering of instrumentation and controls systems in a project team environment for commercial, industrial applications, with a focus on integrated and detailed system design modifications.
  • Professional Engineering license is preferred.
  • Ability to clearly communicate both in speech and written formats.
  • Technically knowledgeable of available equipment and proven pre-engineered systems to execute systems design.
  • Experience with serving as the firm's client liaison in a support or lead engineering role.
  • Experience in reviewing design documentation.

Awards & Benefits

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives.

We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Health & Wellness

  • Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • Disability Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Back-Up Daycare
  • FSA & HSA

Financial Benefits & Perks

  • 401(k)
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Account
  • Merit Scholarship Program
  • Employee Discount Program
  • Corporate Charitable Giving Program
  • Tuition Assistance
  • First Professional Licensure Bonus
  • Employee Referral Bonus

Time Off & Work Patterns

  • Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST)
  • Paid Vacation
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Paid Bereavement Leave
  • Flexible Work Arrangements

Compensation

Compensation Range: $131,960.00 - $205,330.00

About This Business Unit

Join Sargent & Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon-free energy. Since 1954, we’ve been a trusted leader in nuclear engineering, design, and licensing, with expertise spanning small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactor technology (ART), and first-of-a-kind commercial reactor restart projects. Our work supports life extensions and digital modernization of existing nuclear plants, coal-to-nuclear conversion initiatives with the Department of State, and international nuclear new-build projects. With a commitment to safety, innovation, and sustainability, we provide cutting-edge solutions that power communities worldwide while reducing emissions. Shape the future of global energy with us!

Awards & Recognition & Equal Opportunity

title: Gerente de Engagement, AWS Professional Services - Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência
description:
Overview

A equipe Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) está buscando um Gerente de Engajamento (EM) altamente qualificado e versátil para se juntar à nossa equipe e liderar a entrega de projetos complexos de soluções em nuvem. Nesta função, você combinará expertise técnica com fortes habilidades de liderança de projetos para conduzir implementações bem-sucedidas de soluções baseadas em AWS para nossos clientes. Você fará a ponte entre requisitos de negócios e soluções técnicas, facilitando discussões técnicas e garantindo alinhamento com os resultados do cliente. Aplicando frameworks AWS como Well-Architected e Cloud Adoption Framework, enquanto demonstra credibilidade técnica entre diversos stakeholders, você transformará as necessidades do cliente em requisitos técnicos claros, decomporá problemas complexos e tomará decisões informadas considerando desempenho, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto nos negócios.

Possuindo forte experiência em tecnologia e gerenciamento de programas/projetos, você validará soluções técnicas em relação aos objetivos de negócio, reconhecerá quando avaliações técnicas adicionais são necessárias e gerenciará riscos técnicos. Espera-se que você obtenha e mantenha certificações AWS relevantes, desenvolva expertise em domínios específicos e comunique efetivamente conceitos técnicos para públicos técnicos e de negócios. À medida que progredir, você liderará projetos técnicos cada vez mais complexos, moldará estratégias técnicas entre organizações e estabelecerá melhores práticas em seu domínio. Nesta função, você aplicará suas capacidades de gestão e liderança para executar com sucesso planos de projeto, identificar e gerenciar riscos proativamente, resolver problemas, escalar quando apropriado e conduzir projetos a uma conclusão bem-sucedida, superando as expectativas do cliente.

A organização AWS Professional Services é uma equipe global de especialistas que ajudam os clientes a alcançar seus resultados de negócios desejados ao usar a AWS Cloud. Trabalhamos em conjunto com as equipes dos clientes e a AWS Partner Network (APN) para executar iniciativas empresariais de computação em nuvem. Nossa equipe fornece assistência através de uma coleção de ofertas que ajudam os clientes a alcançar resultados específicos relacionados à adoção da nuvem empresarial. Também oferecemos orientação focada através de nossas práticas especializadas globais, que abrangem uma variedade de soluções, tecnologias e indústrias.

Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador(a) e ele(a) lhe conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com objetivo de sermos “a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo”.
Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que “Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades”. Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de D&I, atuando como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o primeiro dia.

Key job responsibilities

Como um gerente de programa/projeto de tecnologia experiente, você será responsável por:

  • Liderar e gerenciar projetos complexos de migração e implementação em nuvem
  • Aproveitar o conhecimento abrangente dos serviços AWS, arquiteturas e melhores práticas para orientar decisões técnicas e planejamento estratégico
  • Fazer a ponte entre requisitos de negócios e soluções técnicas, facilitando discussões de engenharia e garantindo alinhamento com resultados de negócios do cliente
  • Transformar necessidades do cliente em requisitos técnicos claros e mapeá-los para resultados de negócios
  • Decompor problemas técnicos complexos em soluções acionáveis e entregáveis
  • Contribuir para documentação técnica e definir padrões de documentação

About the team

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?: AWS is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from startups to Global 500 companies trust our suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture: Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth: We’re continually raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. You’ll find knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources to help you develop.

Work/Life Balance: We value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility in our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Requisitos mínimos: 3+ anos de experiência em computação em nuvem; 3+ anos de experiência em gerenciamento de projetos de programas técnicos; experiência com atendimento ao cliente e liderança de entrega para grandes programas de transformação; experiência com metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos e ágeis; bacharel ou equivalente; capacidade de se comunicar efetivamente em inglês; experiência com AWS (preferida); PMP e/ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate; forte compreensão dos serviços AWS, arquiteturas e melhores práticas; experiência na aplicação de frameworks AWS como Well-Architected e Cloud Adoption Framework; capacidade de estabelecer credibilidade técnica com equipes de engenharia e tomadores de decisão técnica sêniores; capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e/ou clientes; capacidade de construir relacionamentos com líderes sêniores de negócios e tecnologia (até CSxO).

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation, please visit a information source for accommodations. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Global Energy Manager
description:
Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way. Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

At JLL, we are driving sustainability through everything that we do, across all service lines and job positions. Specifically, we are growing our Sustainability practice to drive end-to-end sustainability solutions in real estate, from site selection to decommissioning.

In this role, you will work directly with one of our clients, implementing the sustainability program across the relevant target sites globally. The role will report into JLL’s Sustainability Operations Global Director in a matrixed organization. Key responsibilities include implementation, optimization and management of a targeted energy management program that delivers measurable savings, carbon reduction, and utilities cost management.

This position is a fully remote position. Being located near a client hub site of Austin, Kansas City, Nashville, Burlington, MA, is a plus but not required.

What this job involves

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute site level energy management strategies for highest impact target sites worldwide.
  • Design and implement sustainability programs targeting measurable savings, carbon reduction, and cost optimization.
  • Identify and prioritize cost-effective energy optimization opportunities that align with existing capital and operational budget frameworks.
  • Partner closely with regional site teams and facility managers to implement energy programs and reach sustainability objectives.
  • Conduct remote or site assessments to identify sustainability conservation opportunities and operational improvement.
  • Drive operational improvements through systematic identification and implementation of energy performance enhancement opportunities and ECMs.
  • Engage with JLL facility managers to become the key point of contact for the provision of advice related to all aspects of environmental sustainability.
  • Support corporate sustainability reporting objectives and provide management information relating to utilities use and environmental impact.
  • Leverage energy, waste, and water data collection processes within JLL’s and client technology platforms and produce monthly and quarterly reports tailored to clients’ requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvements through data analysis and benchmarking.
  • Provide actionable management insights on utility usage patterns.
  • Collaborate with other JLL energy managers globally to share best practices, develop case studies and develop new business opportunities.
  • Develop and optimize systems and processes to deliver industry-leading sustainability performance, utilizing utility and sustainability management platforms for monitoring and reporting.
  • Support cross-functional teams in delivering sustainability projects to meet portfolio-wide sustainability goals.

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we’d encourage you to show your ingenuity.

Requirements – Essential

  • 5+ years energy management experience.
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) Certification.
  • University Degree (Science, engineering, math or related fields).
  • Technical understanding of HVAC, electrical, mechanical, and building automation systems.
  • Proficiency in conducting on-site and desktop assessments to identify water, waste, energy and carbon savings opportunities (e.g. ASHRAE Level 3).
  • In-depth understanding of energy and water conservation measures in the built environment.
  • Experience with benchmarking and analyzing utility data to drive sustainability measures.
  • Experience supporting and managing project delivery by providing technical services guidance and direction to achieve and monitor energy and sustainability project goals.
  • Develop supplier relationships to manage the delivery of environmental and sustainability projects and report on progress made.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with remote teams and implement projects through local partnerships.
  • In-depth understanding of Greenhouse Gas Emission scopes and reporting.
  • Ability to explain complex technical or sensitive information and build consensus across diverse stakeholders.

Requirements – Desirable

  • Experience conducting site walkthroughs to identify conservation measures (e.g. ASHRAE Level 1 and 2).
  • Strong project management skills and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a high-pressure, globally-distributed environment.
  • Experience in preparing tenders and work orders and the ability to select appropriate equipment and service vendors.
  • Knowledge of environmental reporting, utility management and energy budgets, an environmental improvement program, and ISO 14001 compliance.
  • Familiarity with energy procurement processes and renewable energy options.
  • Ability to write recommendation reports for varying audiences (technical and non-technical).
  • Evidence of delivering innovation and engaging positively with continuous change and improvement.
  • Cross-cultural communication skills and international team experience.
  • Experience optimizing energy performance within existing budget constraints.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Think Big - Think strategically, simplify the complex, solve complex problems, see the big picture.
  • Drive Change - Thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive.
  • Helps others - Builds relationships, actively collaborates, helps others succeed.
  • Get it done - Acts decisively, drives results, owns outcomes, accountable, resilient.
  • Business first - Focuses on customers and clients, business/financial acumen, JLL first.
  • Inspire - Inspires others, creates vision and strategy, energizes others.

Estimated compensation for this position: 85,000.00 – 115,000.00 USD per year.

This range is an estimate and actual compensation may differ. Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Location: Remote – Andover, MA, Austin, TX, Boston, MA, Nashville, TN, Topeka, KS.

Benefits

  • 401(k) plan with matching company contributions
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Care
  • Paid parental leave at 100% of salary
  • Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect personal information seriously and process it in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavor to keep personal information secure and retain it only as long as needed for legitimate business or legal reasons.

For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view the Candidate Privacy Statement. For additional details please see our career site pages for each country. For candidates in the United States, please see a full copy of our Equal Employment Opportunity policy here.

Jones Lang LaSalle ("JLL") is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, you may email This email is only to request an accommodation. Please direct any other inquiries to our Contact Us page.

Pursuant to various state and local laws, including but not limited to background checks and fair chance hiring requirements, JLL may consider applications accordingly.

California Residents only

If you are a California resident, please view our Supplemental Privacy Statement that describes your rights and disclosures about your personal information.

Accepting applications on an ongoing basis until a candidate is identified.

Company Description

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and engineers in 2016, Pismo is a technology company that provides a comprehensive processing platform for banking, card issuing and financial market infrastructure and helps customers innovate and build the next generation of banking and payment solutions. Pismo joined Visa in 2024.

Leveraging Visa’s solutions, our core platform, and an expanding suite of capabilities, Pismo addresses the technological challenges that large banks, marketplaces, and fintech companies face in migrating from legacy systems to more advanced technology in the market. Pismo’s cloud-based platform empowers firms to build and launch financial products rapidly, scaling as they grow to have a broader audience while keeping high security and availability standards.

Pismo’s 500+ employees are located in more than 10 countries around the world.

Job Description

Pismo is seeking a Client Success Consultant to support new and existing customers (B2B), helping to drive retention, increase users’ engagement, and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. The Client Success Consultant acts as a trusted advisor to our customer, helps communicate the value of the Pismo products, and responds to customer needs, questions and requests. You will not personally perform projects or resolve issues for the customer. However, you will work closely with internal teams and will be responsible for actively managing clients’ requests. You are expected to be able to navigate through different areas and levels at Pismo.

We expect you to:

  • Build long-term strategic relationships with key stakeholders in your portfolio and develop a deep understanding of your customers’ business processes, goals, and strategies.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned accounts, fostering trust and confidence in our partnership.

  • Meet with customers on a regular basis to discuss business and tactical challenges they may be facing, to understand their definition of success with Pismo, and to offer proactive advice on how to optimize or enhance the use of Pismo platform.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the customer's business and industry to provide solutions and advice.

  • Work closely with customers to create and execute a successful plan that aligns with their business objectives and strategy. Also, maximize the value they receive from our solutions, by managing program engagements.

  • Act as a customer advocate within the company, being the voice of the customer, representing their feedback and needs.

  • Ensure timely resolution of customer issues, working closely across Pismo teams.

  • Manage and follow up on client’s KPIs within Pismo (developments execution, platform performance and others).

  • Analyze and have critical thought on clients’ data to perform a strategic analysis and take decisions based on data.

  • Provide education and resources to customers to enable them to effectively use our products/services.

  • Conduct regular check-ins to ensure customers are leveraging the full capabilities of our offerings.

  • Influence the company to adapt or create new processes with a focus to provide better experience to our customers. Continuously improve the Client Success area, partnering with your peers to scale the organizational capabilities.

  • Coordinate with the Account Manager (Sales) to create and share roadmaps on customers’ functional use of Pismo Products and contributing to long-term strategic planning.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Customer Success (preferable) or similar roles, ideally in a hyper-growth environment of B2B model;
  • Industry experience in Payments, Cards processing and Banking;
  • The ideal candidate is a proactive person, driven by data to anticipate problems.
  • Ability to develop a continuous and evolutive job to straighten the relationship with clients and establish technical discussions with clients.
  • Program management capability;
  • Structured and critical thinking and high focus on strategy and results;
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical, writing, and communication skills;
  • Innovator soul and receptive to changes;
  • Ability to develop strong relationships at C-level of enterprise companies;
  • Influence ability to implement new processes that result in a client excellence experience;
  • Track record of high customer satisfaction;
  • Experience working with a full lifecycle of customer success;
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice-to-have:

  • Technical related expertise (development, infrastructure, familiarity with architectural design), Cloud knowledge (AWS, Azzure, Google).
  • Proficiency in Spanish is considered an advantage.

Additional Information

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

The Role

This helps them get ahead financially, while businesses get a clearer, more efficient view of their customers.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Application Security Engineer role at Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We have raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain's growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain's application and platform security posture. This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container/Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vulnerability, credential stuffing, web/API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain's architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code reviews or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React/React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.

title: Payments Systems Analyst
description:
Role Overview

This is a highly specialized, hands-on role focused on credit, debit, and prepaid card issuing and transaction processing. The Payments Systems Analyst will serve as the subject-matter expert in Visa and Mastercard network specifications, ensuring compliance with mandates, cryptographic standards, and operational excellence. The analyst will bridge engineering, product, and operations by maintaining deep technical documentation, building test frameworks, and guiding the company’s adherence to ISO 8583, EMV, PCI DSS, and card brand requirements.

Analysis & Specification

  • Interpret and maintain Visa/Mastercard specifications and internal documentation (fields/DEs, bitmaps, BCD/ASCII/EBCDIC, LLVAR/LLLVAR encodings).
  • Model and review critical ISO 8583 content: DE55 (EMV tags/BER-TLV), DE52 (PIN Data), DE35/45 (Track2/Track1), DE44/48/60/61/63/127, DE39 response codes, etc.
  • Define business rules by MTI and by product (POS, e-commerce, ATM, wallets/tokenization).
  • Align with Visa/Mastercard requirements to avoid operational or financial impacts from non-compliance.

Quality Assurance

  • Create test plans, regression suites, and compliance contracts by card brand.
  • Build and maintain “golden” messages and negative scenarios (field fuzzing, invalid lengths, corrupted data).

As a Senior Software Development Engineer focused on Unreal gameplay programming, you'll continue to grow your expertise in writing high-quality code while learning and using whatever breadth of skills are needed to make a game awesome for players. That may include adding functionality in Unreal Engine, writing gameplay features, or something else entirely. Teaching others first and maintaining a mentorship culture are key ingredients to our success.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the skills listed here. We understand that your qualifications may shine through in different ways and can be based on unique perspectives and experiences.

Gamebreaking Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity, and are committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for our team.

Desired Skills & Qualifications

  • A passion for games and entertainment that shows. Whether you love video games, board games, cosplay, or freeze tag — we want to know! If it doesn’t shine through your resume (e.g. work, academic, or community experience), please submit a cover letter
  • 5+ years of professional game programming experience
  • Experience working in a large, established code base
  • Deep knowledge of C++ programming and best practices
  • Flexibility and desire to work on a variety of game systems
  • Experience developing with Unreal Engine 4/5 is a plus

Your Responsibilities

  • Write code that is clear, well-tested and modular.
  • Architect and implement features with an eye towards performance and maintainability
  • Assist game teams with technology choices and follow through with implementation.
  • Mentor more junior engineers via paired programming and code reviews.
  • Work with project managers inside and outside our studio to deliver features to players.

Our Responsibilities To You

  • Encourage healthy working hours, PTO, and a respect for your time.
  • Foster an environment of equal opportunity, treatment, and inclusion.
  • Create a fun and playful environment that remains professional and respectful.
  • Grow our culture positively and meaningfully through a high level of transparency and thoughtful conversation.
  • Provide opportunities for you to learn and grow.

Potential Roles and Growth Paths (Choose One)

  • Tech Lead — Lead a tech team through mentorship, setting code standards, and designing and building systems.

  • DIY — A small company means big opportunities if you're willing to forge your path, and we're here to support you!
  • Full Health Benefits — Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Open PTO
  • Fully Remote Work
  • Annual Company Retreat

About Gamebreaking

Gamebreaking Studios is a young, growing, LA-based company founded by technology leaders from around games, entertainment, and software. We found early success providing work-for-hire to other studios and now build everything from end-to-end games to online game platforms to individual feature integrations. We also develop our own games and IP alongside other projects.

Our mission: We aspire to make games and media so fun that it improves people's relationships and behaviors. That is to say, while we are not a "serious games" company, we believe that making fun-first games enables us to have a positive impact. We believe deeply in our core values and hope to find people who share them:

  • Take Responsibility
  • Raise The Tide, Not One Boat
  • Ambitious Goals, Disciplined Execution
  • Design For People, Own Your Craft
  • We Play Together

L iving and working outside the US at Gamebreaking

This position is open to candidates living and working throughout Latin America (pay varies by location). Applicants must be fluent in English, willing to work according to US time zones (must be available 8am - 3pm Pacific Time), and have a strong, stable internet connection conducive to remote work and video calls. Outside the US, we work with an Employer of Record (deel.com) to hire full-time employees. This works very similar to how employees would work for a company based in their home country. Each lead is assigned to strategic projects across the organization, combining hands-on technical implementation with leadership to achieve measurable productivity improvements.   • Strategic GenAI Opportunity Identification: Lead the collaborative effort with software development teams to pinpoint strategic engineering workflows within the SDLC where Generative AI can deliver substantial and scalable productivity gains.

  • Technical Implementation Leadership: Provide strong technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams during the design, implementation, and integration phases of Gen AI solutions, ensuring adherence to architectural standards and best practices.
  • Driving Scalable GenAI Solutions & Best Practices: Architect and champion the development and adoption of robust best practices for the secure, effective, and scalable integration of Gen AI within the SDLC across N-iX engineering.
  • Create data-driven case studies with hard metrics (story points, cycle time, defect rates) that prove ROI to executives and clients.

Requirements:

  • Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and extensive practical experience leading technical efforts across various development workflows.
  • Extensive and demonstrable experience as a Lead Java developer with a deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices in software development.
  • Direct, hands-on experience leading the implementation of specific Gen AI tools relevant to software development within engineering teams (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AI-powered testing frameworks).
  • Significant experience leading and mentoring technical teams in the adoption of new technologies.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical visions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and drive adoption.
  • Extensive experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and a proven track record of leading technical teams within these frameworks.

What You’ll Actually Do:

Overview


As a FULL STACK DEVELOPER, you will work on multiple projects that may span a broad range of applications as a project team member, sometimes as a project lead. You may require expertise in multiple technical environments and business knowledge that spans one or more business areas.


As a Full Stack Developer, you must be able to adjust to constant business change and as needed to proactively plan for changes that are likely to occur. Common types of changes include introduction of new organizations through mergers and acquisitions, the separation of parts of organization (as subsidiaries, or when the business changes direction), evolving goals and strategies and emerging technologies. These changes require integration of solutions that can impact the overall system development activity. Application Developers also provide client support, consultation and subject matter expertise for system development, maintenance and support.


In this job family you will work closely with clients, business analysts and team members to understand the business requirements that drive the analysis and design of quality technical solutions. These solutions must be aligned with business and IT strategies and are in compliance with the organization’s architectural standards. Application Developers are involved in the full systems life cycle and therefore are responsible for designing, coding, testing, implementing and supporting application software that is delivered on time and within budget. Responsibilities beyond development of software may include participation in component and data architecture design, technology planning, product evaluation, advanced testing processes and buy vs. build recommendations. Individuals also provide input to project plans related to the Application Development initiative.


As a Full Stack Application Developer, you need to have a strong knowledge of programming languages used by the organization.   • DATA REQUIREMENTS

    Identifies better sources of data feeds and interfaces with architects to ensure their feasibility with corporate data warehouse, when needed. Actively participates in planning sessions with Architecture team to define, plan, analyze, implement and operationalize enterprise data model.


  • DESIGN

  • CODE AND TEST

Integrates solutions with other applications and platforms outside the framework. Creates data extracts and reports from system based requirements. Develops, executes and documents test plans.


  • DEPLOYMENT

  • MAINTENANCE (BREAK/FIX)

Participates on teams that outline the process and scope out the improvements that can be realized through the application solution.

title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Sweden needs skilled engineers!

About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Required competence

  • At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of at least a handful of contemporary IT technologies and methods, as well as the ability to learn the main ideas of new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with an eye for details, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and stubborn, with the capacity to take a 'no' as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Extent & Duration

Start ASAP. Full time. Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.

Location

You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.

Economy

Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays, with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

Application

Please send your English CV to: ******. Please state the application code TEL2025HH in the subject of your email.

title: Network Manager
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Ready to create a healthier world? We are ready for you! Personify Health is on a mission to simplify and personalize the health experience to improve health and reduce costs for companies and their people. At Personify Health, we believe in offering total rewards, flexible opportunities, and a diverse inclusive community, where every voice matters. Together, we’re shaping a healthier, more engaged future.

Responsibilities

Ready to Drive Excellence Across Diverse Network Partnerships?

We're seeking a strategic operational leader who can manage the ongoing performance of our diverse portfolio of leased carrier networks while serving as a direct extension of the Director of Network Management. As our Network Manager, you'll ensure internal operational excellence while supporting the strategic success of our network products, including leased networks and COE partners.

What makes this role different

  • Portfolio management: Oversee diverse network partnerships including secondary, regional, and dental networks with comprehensive performance monitoring
  • Strategic insights: Develop performance dashboards that deliver actionable insights driving business decisions for leadership and client account teams
  • Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with Claims Operations, Clinical teams, and Commercial teams to ensure operational alignment and excellence
  • Implementation leadership: Support GTM new network implementation with project management expertise and operational readiness coordination

What You'll Actually Do

  • Drive network performance excellence: Report on network performance focusing on KPIs including performance guarantees, client and membership growth, network revenue, product utilization, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintain operational oversight: Develop network management documentation, prepare internal updates, manage contracts, and serve as primary contact for operational issues and processes.
  • Monitor compliance rigorously: Track performance guarantees for all networks, ensure accurate delivery of network scorecards, and review data for ongoing compliance with membership growth targets and claims timeliness.
  • Resolve complex escalations: Lead research and resolution of service requests including complex client escalations related to network issues while collaborating with networks on training coordination.
  • Support strategic initiatives: Provide GTM new network implementation support, organize network notifications processes, and contribute to strategic development of network management capabilities.
  • Enable internal teams: Support Claims Operations by providing clarity on unique operational and contractual nuances of each network while building collaborative relationships with Commercial and Operations Enablement teams.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Mission

  • The operational foundation:
    • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (equivalent work experience considered)
    • 2-4 years experience in provider network management, provider relations, or healthcare operations
    • Experience within TPA, health plan, or health system environment
  • The analytical expertise:
    • Demonstrated experience with different provider reimbursement models including fee-for-service
    • Understanding of value-based care concepts (ACOs, Clinically Integrated Networks)
    • Proven ability to analyze healthcare data (claims, provider, network, eligibility) to identify trends and solve problems
  • The professional competencies:
    • Relationship building: Natural ability to build rapport and establish trust with clients, providers, and internal colleagues
    • Analytical mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with talent for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights
    • Project management: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively
    • Communication excellence: Exceptional written and verbal skills for presenting information clearly to diverse audiences
    • Autonomy and initiative: Self-starter who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and navigate ambiguity in dynamic environments
    • Technical proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) with comfort learning new claims and provider management software

Why You'll Love It Here

We believe in total rewards that actually matter—not just competitive packages, but benefits that support how you want to live and work.

Your wellbeing and Benefits

  • Your wellbeing comes first: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build!)
  • Mental health support and wellness programs designed by experts who get it
  • Flexible work arrangements that fit your life, not the other way around
  • Financial security that makes sense: Retirement planning support to help you build real wealth for the future
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance plus Short-Term and Long-Term Disability protection
  • Employee savings programs and voluntary benefits like Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • Growth without limits: Professional development opportunities and clear career progression paths
  • Mentorship from industry leaders who want to see you succeed
  • Learning budget to invest in skills that matter to your future

A culture that energizes

  • People Matter: Inclusive community where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation
  • One Team One Dream: Collaborative environment where we celebrate wins together and support each other through challenges
  • We Deliver: Mission-driven work that creates real impact on people's health and wellbeing, with clear accountability for results
  • Grow Forward: Continuous learning mindset with team events, recognition programs, and celebrations that make work genuinely enjoyable

The practical stuff

  • Competitive base salary plus bonus structure that rewards your success
  • Unlimited PTO policy because rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Benefits effective day one—because you shouldn’t have to wait to be taken care of

Ready to create a healthier world? We're ready for you.

No candidate will meet every single qualification listed. If your experience looks different but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to learn more about you.

Personify Health is an equal opportunity organization and is committed to diversity, inclusion, equity, and social justice.

In compliance with all states and cities that require transparency of pay, the base compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 to $120,000. Note that compensation may vary based on location, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for 10% target bonus/variable compensation as well as health, dental, vision, mental health and other benefits.

We strive to cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive. Personify Health is committed to driving Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) for all stakeholders: employees (at each organization level), members, clients and the communities in which we operate. Diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

#WeAreHiring #PersonifyHealth

Beware of Hiring Scams: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information such as social security numbers during the hiring process. All official communication will come from a verified company email address. If you receive suspicious requests or communications, please report them All of our legitimate openings can be found on the Personify HealthCareer Site.

  • Programar, Solicitar e Controlar a utilização dos recursos de manutenção (Andaimes, Mão de Obra, Equipamentos e etc.);
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades programadas junto a equipe de Execução e acompanhar a apropriação de parametros de realização no SAP;
  • Providenciar a disponibilidade das peças/materiais de acordo com as solicitações de reservas para as manutenções programadas;
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades de armazenagem e solicitações de materiais para ordens de manutenção;
  • Comunicar resultados que envolvam a programação de Ordens de Manutenção (Desenvolver e divulgar relatórios, participar de reuniões e etc.);
  • Balancear a utilização dos recursos de manutenção (Andaimes, Mão de Obra, Equipamentos e etc.) dentro da programação de Ordens de Manutenção;
  • Controlar e analisar indicadores de manutenção que envolvam a programação de Ordens de Manutenção (Ex.: Back Log, Índice de Execução e etc.);

  • Organizar e/ou participar de visitas técnicas relativas as atividades a serem executadas na Programação de Ordens de Manutenção;
  • Apoiar a Engenharia de Manutenção e/ou a Inspeção / Manutenção em atividades que envolvam Planejamento de Manutenção (Detalhamento de Escopo, determinação de recursos, geração de pontos de melhoria, analise de falhas e etc.);
  • Programar Ordens de Manutenção na Parada de Manutenção;
  • Preparar e liderar reuniões de cronograma e avaliação de Paradas de Manutenção;
  • Desenvolver Planejamento de grandes paradas de manutenção (PGP) em sua área de atuação, atendendo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos planejadores em sua área de atuação, em todo o processo de planejamento de manutenção de rotina, preventiva e Grandes paradas.
  • Contribuir para prática de atividades de metodologia 5s que envolve: Utilização, Arrumação, Limpeza, Padronização e Disciplina no ambiente de trabalho.

  • Formação técnica em mecânica e/ou cursos correlacionados concluídos.
  • CFT Ativo.
  • Experiência nas atividades descritas.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de turno.
  • Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Formada e liderada por professores do Departamento de Engenharia de Produção da Escola Politécnica da Universidade de São Paulo (Poli-USP), a Fundação Vanzolini é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, que traduz o conhecimento acadêmico em ações de impacto. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and engineers in 2016, Pismo is a technology company that provides a comprehensive processing platform for banking, card issuing and financial market infrastructure and helps customers innovate and build the next generation of banking and payment solutions. Pismo joined Visa in 2024.

Leveraging Visa’s solutions, our core platform, and an expanding suite of capabilities, Pismo addresses the technological challenges that large banks, marketplaces, and fintech companies face in migrating from legacy systems to more advanced technology in the market. Pismo’s cloud-based platform empowers firms to build and launch financial products rapidly, scaling as they grow to have a broader audience while keeping high security and availability standards.

Pismo’s 500+ employees are located in more than 10 countries around the world.

Job Description

Summary

Pismo’s Platform squad is responsible for maintaining the life-cycle (bootstrap, maintenance and decommission) the following domains: Container orchestration (through Kubernetes), Cloud Architecture and Networking (Cloud and On-premise).

What you\'ll do

The engineer will support the Kubernetes and Service Mesh (Istio) lifecycle within the platform squad by:

  • Creating and/or enhancing mechanisms to bootstrap
  • Observe (monitoring)
  • Maintain (including upgrades)
  • Decommission these resources using infrastructure-as-code and cloud-native best practices across several clusters.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI-Remote

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience.
  • The candidate must possess strong expertise in Kubernetes and Service Mesh (ideally, Istio), with proven experience supporting both day-to-day operations and business-driven initiatives.
  • This role requires a hands-on approach to managing cloud-native infrastructure, with all tasks executed through Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)—preferably using Terraform—and aligned with GitOps methodologies within a fully automated CI/CD pipeline.
  • A solid foundation in English communication is essential, as the role involves regular collaboration with team members located outside Brazil.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Basic knowledge in script development
  • Basic knowledge in AWS services (S3 Bucket, Dynamo\'s Table, IAM, EC2)

Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

VEM SER GUARACAMP !

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marcaraiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos oGuaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco no resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.Aqui,buscamos gente boa para formar um time forte , com atitude de dono, espírito de realização e sede por evolução. Valorizamos quem acredita quetudo pode ser feito melhor , comtransparência, disciplina e vontade de fazer acontecer . Se você se identifica com esses princípios e querdeixar sua marca no mundo , seu lugar é com a gente!

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: O Gerente Geral Comercial será responsável por liderar e gerenciar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, incluindo vendas internas, externas, revendas e parcerias. Seu principal objetivo é otimizar os resultados comerciais, impulsionando as vendas, garantindo a execução das estratégias de mercado, e o alinhamento de todos os times comerciais. O profissional deverá ter uma visão estratégica, orientada para a análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de novos canais e parcerias, e promover a evolução contínua das equipes sob sua gestão.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Gestão dos Canais de Vendas: Supervisionar todos os canais de vendas da empresa, garantindo que as metas de vendas sejam alcançadas em cada segmento (interno, externo, revendas, etc.).
• Planejamento Estratégico: Criar e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a performance de vendas em todos os canais, com foco na expansão e otimização dos resultados comerciais.
• Análise de Desempenho Comercial: Monitorar o desempenho de cada canal de vendas, identificando tendências, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Utilizar essas informações para ajustar as estratégias de vendas e maximizar a participação de mercado.
• Acompanhamento de Indicadores: Analisar e acompanhar semanalmente os relatórios de vendas, desempenho e KPIs, fazendo ajustes necessários para garantir o atingimento das metas estabelecidas.
• Desenvolvimento de Novas Parcerias: Identificar novas oportunidades de parcerias estratégicas que possam fortalecer a rede de canais de vendas e ampliar a capilaridade do mercado.
• Pesquisa de Mercado: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado, concorrência e tendências, com o objetivo de fornecer insights e propostas de ação para a área comercial.
• Treinamento e Desenvolvimento: Planejar e coordenar treinamentos para gerentes de vendas, supervisores e equipes comerciais, visando aprimorar as competências técnicas e comportamentais.
• Gestão de Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com parceiros comerciais, clientes-chave e outros stakeholders, promovendo o crescimento e a fidelização.
• Suporte a Gerentes e Supervisores: Oferecer suporte contínuo aos gerentes de unidades e supervisores, fornecendo orientações, ferramentas e recursos necessários para o atingimento das metas comerciais.
• Coordenação de Projetos Comerciais: Gerenciar projetos comerciais estratégicos, desde a concepção até a execução, garantindo a implementação eficaz e os resultados esperados.
• Ajustes e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos comerciais, utilizando feedbacks de equipe, clientes e mercado para refinar as práticas de vendas e aumentar a produtividade.
• Gestão do Orçamento Comercial: Controlar e gerenciar os custos comerciais, garantindo que as ações sejam realizadas dentro do orçamento previsto e que haja uma boa alocação de recursos.
• Análise de Concorrência: Acompanhar de perto as estratégias de concorrentes e realizar ajustes nas estratégias internas para manter ou aumentar a competitividade da empresa.

REQUISITOS:

1. Ensino Superior Completo. Desejável Pós Graduação ou MBA na área
2. Atuação anterior em gestão na área comercial com entendimento de todos os canais (direto e indireto)
3. Pacote Office avançado
4. CNH tipo B

HABILIDADES:

1. Visão de Mercado
2. Liderança
3. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade
4. Orientação para Resultados

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA
description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Salary - Annually: Step I - 101,540.00 USD

Post Adjustment - Annually: 30,563.54 USD

Contractual Agreement: Staff - Professional Post

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Disclaimer & Application Details

  • This vacancy notice may be used to fill other similar positions at the same grade and level.

  • All applicants are required to complete an online profile to be considered for this post.

  • Candidates will be contacted only if they are under serious consideration.

  • If selected for interview, provide scanned copies of required degrees/certificates. PAHO considers official qualifications from accredited institutions as recognized by WHED/IAU/UNESCO, CHEA, and NCES.

  • Assessment of credentials can be performed via listed sources: World Higher Education Database (WHED), Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and College Navigator (NCES).

  • Links (plain text): whed.net, chea.org, nces.gov.

  • Any appointment/extension is subject to PAHO Staff Regulations, Staff Rules and e-Manual.

PAHO/WHO is committed to:

  • PAHO supports an environment of mutual respect and dignity for all applicants. All interested individuals who meet the requirements are encouraged to apply.

  • Persons with disabilities can request reasonable accommodations to participate in recruitment; contact

  • Maintaining high standards of integrity and accountability in professional and personal activities.

  • Promoting a work environment free from harassment, discrimination, and abusive behavior. Background checks will be conducted.

  • Providing a smoke-free environment.

  • Zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse; wrongdoing may lead to termination and legal action.

description:
Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Naval - Casco Externo


Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee


Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!


Garantir a integridade naval por meio do planejamento e execução de inspeções e reparos baseados em risco, gestão de UWILD, amarras, mangotes e hawser, interação com Classe/Bandeira, assegurando conformidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.


Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento e a colaboração dos colegas de trabalho e da equipe. Atuar com foco em segurança operacional, excelência técnica e cultura de prevenção, garantindo que as atividades sejam realizadas com responsabilidade, eficiência e respeito à vida.



  • Planejar e executar o programa de integridade naval , priorizando por risco (RBI), analisando relatórios de classe, UWILD, mooring, definindo escopos e workpacks de inspeção e reparo; manter dashboard e registro de anomalias.

  • Conduzir campanhas UWILD , preparando escopo, selecionando métodos (GVI/CVI por ROV, END focal e leituras de CP), minimizando mergulho, para cumprir requisitos e evidências de Classe para UWILD.

  • Gerir mangotes de offloading e hawser , implementando rotina de inspeção, recertificação, critérios de aceitação e descarte, controle de sobressalentes e definir planos de execução

  • Assegurar integridade de amarras do sistema de ancoragem , aplicando gestão de integridade ao longo do ciclo de vida, incluindo inspeção, avaliação de desgaste e tensão, plano de substituição.

  • Interagir com Classe/Bandeira , atendendo inspeções, respondendo findings, comprovando correções e mantendo dossiês técnicos para auditorias e vistorias.

  • Coordenar SIMOPS e logística de inspeções , planejando janelas, alinhando AHTS/apoio, e privilegiar soluções “no dive” sempre que possível.

  • Padronizar normas e procedimentos internos , redigindo e atualizando procedimentos para casco, amarras e offloading; treinar equipes e garantir aderência

  • Gerir terceiros e QA/QC , qualificando fornecedores, conduzindo kick offs, supervisionando execução, validando relatórios com evidências e KPIs e promovendo a execução com total segurança

  • Documentar e medir desempenho , mantendo o SAP e repositório técnico atualizados com planos, certificados, relatórios, e registros de anomalias; reportar KPIs de integridade e conformidade.



Formação Acadêmica:



  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Naval, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Engenharia de Confiabilidade, Gestão de Ativos, Projetos ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.



Conhecimentos Técnicos Específicos:



  • Sólido conhecimento em normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis à integridade de ativos offshore, API, ASME, DNV, ABS e normas da Marinha do Brasil.

  • Domínio de metodologias de inspeção baseadas em risco (RBI), análise de falhas (RCFA), gestão de anomalias e planos de inspeção e teste (ITP).



Ferramentas e Sistemas:



  • Experiência avançada com SAP PM para gestão de manutenção e inspeções, ferramentas de análise de dados como Excel avançado e Power BI, além de softwares de engenharia e modelagem estrutural (ex: AutoPIPE, ANSYS, OrcaFlex). Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera) e sistemas de controle de MOCs e não conformidades.



Certificações e Treinamentos Regulatórios:



  • Treinamentos obrigatórios para atuação offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-10, NR-35, entre outros) devem estar atualizados conforme exigência legal.

  • Inglês avançado para leitura e fala, interpretação de normas técnicas internacionais, elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com entidades certificadoras e fornecedores.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.


Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!



Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:


-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;


-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.
