Cuidar da saúde mental no trabalho é muito mais do que uma prática possível: é dever de toda empresa que leva a sério a si mesma e as equipes que, todos os dias, a mantêm de pé. Para se ter uma ideia da dimensão dessa necessidade, é só conferir as pesquisas recentes sobre o assunto. Conforme dados do Ministério da Previdência Social divulgados pela Revista Veja, grande parte dos afastamentos em 2024 foi em razão de transtornos de ansiedade (141.414), seguidos por episódios depressivos (113.604) e por transtorno depressivo recorrente (52.627). Somente os afastamentos por ansiedade aumentaram mais de 400% na última década. E os casos de depressão quase dobraram. Ainda assim, quando abordamos esse tema, ele muitas vezes chega aos ouvidos como se fosse um assunto delicado a ponto de parecer intocável. Será que ainda precisamos de tanto receio em pleno 2025? Ao contrário do que se imagina, implementar medidas de cuidado emocional no ambiente corporativo não exige grandes investimentos, mas sim pequenas mudanças com alto impacto: ️ Incentivar pausas reais (sem culpa) ️ Treinar lideranças para escuta ativa ️ Normalizar conversas sobre saúde mental, sem tabu ou julgamento ️ Reavaliar aspectos da cultura organizacional que reforçam o silêncio ️ Criar espaços seguros para pedir ajuda sem medo de retaliação Cuidar da saúde mental no ambiente corporativo não é “mimar” equipes. É preservar o recurso mais valioso que uma empresa pode ter: pessoas inteiras, conectadas e capazes de sustentar resultados sem adoecer no processo.E aqui vai o ponto crucial: saúde mental não se resolve com uma ação no Setembro Amarelo e uma palestra por ano. Ela se constrói no cotidiano, com insistência e consistência.E aí, sua empresa está pronta para essa mudança, ou vai continuar apenas comprando balões amarelos?Fonte: #InstitutoVitaAlere #SaúdeMental #CulturaOrganizacional #AmbienteDeTrabalho #RHHumanizado #SegurançaPsicológica #GestãoDePessoas #BemEstarNoTrabalho

Senior Product Manager - Cards Payments Optimization

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager - Cards Payments Optimization role at dLocal

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About dLocal

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

About Dlocal
Dlocal powers payments in emerging markets, helping global companies collect and send funds using local rails.

What will I be doing?

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for card payments optimization, with a focus on increasing approval rates and transaction success
  • Launch and scale high-impact card payment features such as network tokenization, account updater, optimized routing, and advanced retry logic
  • Partner with card networks (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) and acquirers to leverage the latest capabilities and best practices
  • Collaborate with engineering, data, and merchant-facing teams to design and implement optimizations
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of approval and decline patterns to uncover opportunities for improvement
  • Work closely with merchants to align on optimization strategies and tailor solutions to their markets and business models
  • Design experiments, A/B tests, and rollout plans to validate performance improvements before scaling
  • Monitor competitive trends and regulatory changes impacting card payments in emerging markets

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of product management experience in payments, fintech, or related fields
  • Deep understanding of card payment flows, including authorization, settlement, and network capabilities
  • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in card payment performance
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data tools (e.g., SQL, BI platforms) to drive decisions
  • Excellent relationship management skills with external partners such as card networks and acquirers
  • Proven ability to prioritize and deliver high-impact product changes in fast-paced environments

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity

  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment
description:
Overview

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM.
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform.
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization.
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform.
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats.
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation.
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement.
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise.
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR.
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO.
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments.
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows.
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence.
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules.
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus.
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex).
  • Relevant bachelor’s degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations at paloaltonetworks dot com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide, we provide AI technology solutions for many of the world\'s largest technology companies and leaders across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we help usher in the promise of AI. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge with a focus on microbiological sciences. You will evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts that assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • English language assessment is required as part of the project (mandatory and non-billable).

Overview

As a Lead Generation Specialist at EK Health under the supervision of the Director of Business Development, you will be the first spark in our sales engine, identifying and qualifying prospective clients, initiating outreach, and creating opportunities that fuel business growth. Through phone calls, emails, campaigns, and event follow-up, you'll generate quality leads that set our Sales Team up for success. Your efforts will directly contribute to helping injured workers recover faster and to strengthening EK Health's relationships with clients.

Work Specifics: Non-Exempt, eight (8) hour workday, Monday-Friday. Remote or in-office position, business hours. Note: This role will require minimal travel to trade shows/events (3-4 per year).

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and qualify prospective clients in EK Health's target markets.
  • Conduct outreach via calls, emails, and campaigns to uncover needs and introduce our solutions.
  • Schedule sales appointments, demos, and meetings for the Sales Team.
  • Track and manage lead activity in CRM to ensure high conversion visibility and accurate reporting.
  • Support marketing campaigns, tradeshows, and event follow-ups to maximize lead generation ROI.
  • Gather and share market and competitor insights to enhance business development strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to meet and exceed lead generation goals.

Other Responsibilities

  • Represent EK Health professionally in all communications and interactions.
  • Work independently and as part of a team to achieve productivity and performance targets.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Pay & Perks

  • Pay ~ $55K Annually
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • 401K
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Monthly internet stipend

Core Competencies

  • Integrity & Trust - Acts with honesty and professionalism, building confidence with colleagues and prospects
  • Customer Focus - Listens first, understands client needs, and creates a positive first impression that opens doors
  • Action Oriented - Energetic, proactive, and persistent in pursuing opportunities and driving results
  • Time & Priority Management - Skilled at organizing tasks, meeting deadlines, and staying focused on what moves the needle
  • Resilience & Composure - Handles challenges with a steady, solutions-focused mindset
  • Collaborative Communicator - Connects easily with others, shares information openly, and works seamlessly with the Sales and Marketing teams to achieve shared goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3-5 years of lead generation, inside sales, or telemarketing experience; Workers' Compensation or healthcare preferred.
  • Proven success meeting lead generation and appointment-setting goals.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; confident in "selling by phone."
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation software; HubSpot proficiency preferred.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and skilled at managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to work remotely with a HIPAA-compliant home office and reliable high-speed internet.
  • Occasional travel may be required for trade shows or events.
  • Must be able to lift to 25lbs.

Physical Requirements

The candidate must be able to sit for most of an 8-hour day, except for lunch and break times. The candidate must be able to type for most of an 8-hour day, except for lunch and break times. The candidate must have manual dexterity. The candidate must be able to speak on the telephone intermittently throughout the day. The candidate must be able to read and write English fluently. The candidate must be able to provide and confirm a safe home office environment. The home office must be HIPAA compliant.

*Requires DSL, fiber, or cable internet connection from home, 100 Mbps preferred or better.*

title: CONSULTOR(A) NEGOCIOS - RJ (Banco de Talentos)
description:
Job description

QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, porisso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual,raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novosdesafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

Main responsibilities

DADOS:

GS 16

Local: Rio de Janeiro

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responder pela Ex-Mill, Margem de Contribuição, Volume, Faturamento, Distribuição Numérica e Ponderada - dentre outros indicadores de sua região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela companhia;
  • Atuar de acordo com a Rotina de Trabalho Suzano estabelecida para os clientes/canais de atendimento Direto ou Indireto, independente do modelo: Matricial ou Dedicado;
  • Garantir a execução SUZANO no PDV (Loja Perfeita) - Mix Mínimo, Planograma, Precificação, Qualidade, Exposição e presença de Material de PDV;
  • Presença no Mercado (área sob sua responsabilidade) de acordo com a definição do Processo de Vendas, identificando oportunidades e ameaças da concorrência;
  • Aplicar a política comercial Suzano de acordo com a estratégia para a região, canal ou cliente sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua do resultado de seus clientes, garantindo assim a manutenção de sua carteira;
  • Estabelecer Planos de Negócios – JBP, para as contas/clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas e clientes sob sua responsabilidade: monitoramento de estoques, colocação de pedidos, acompanhamento do faturamento, monitoramento das entregas e monitoramento dos pagamentos, entre outras atividades, inerentes a função;
  • Realizar o planejamento colaborativo de Demanda de produtos;
  • Prospectar clientes com potencial e que estejam dentro do perfil de produtos SUZANO;
  • Explorar detalhadamente cada ponto da sua verba off-invoice, quando disponível;
  • Atuar e monitorar o Sell Out nos seus clientes, sugerindo promoções, ações de merchandising ou campanhas que atinjam os consumidores dos seus produtos;
  • Avaliar seu próprio desempenho e propor-se um plano de melhoria operacional continuamente;
  • Ter domínio sobre condições comerciais expressas nos contratos realizados com os clientes de sua carteira.

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Conhecer do mercado e clientes de bens de consumo do mercado/da região;
  • Ter conhecimento dos clientes e varejistas da região de atuação;
  • Ser dinâmico, comunicativo, negociador, proativo, resiliente e com foco em resultados.

Additional information

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de RemuneraçãoVariável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá setornar um voluntário do nossoprograma Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidadepara 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe quetiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no finaldo ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola,reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

Você poderá...

Participar do #GrupoDeCorridaSuzano , um projeto pensado para manter a sua saúde em dia;

Receber atendimento nutricional;

Praticar ginástica laboral;

Usar o Gympass na academia de sua preferência, salas com manicure e massagem;

Aproveitar o Espaço Faz Bem com mesas de jogos. E, se você jogar um bolão, por aqui sempre realizamos e incentivamos os campeonatos internos!

Contar com a assessoria do Disque Viver Bem, para atendimentos via 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, nutricionistas, pet consultoria, educadores físicos eprofissionais da área jurídica.

Done right, your work sets the tone, style, and pacing of the visuals for each upload.

The goal is to take a 3D model we've created, like the inside of a submarine, and bring it to life using static characters and voice-over, all coming together into one final video. We\'re not looking to create test animatics or rough drafts. The aim is to go straight to producing the final version.

  • Can create animatics that feel — emotionally powerful moments that land
  • Brings ideas to the table, not just drawings
  • Is constantly studying great visuals — from movies to sci-fi to docs
  • Is proactive, fast to respond, and excited to grow with us

Good to Haves

  • Can manage animation timelines and teams (as we scale)
  • Understand YouTube audience retention and how visuals play a part
  • Have a strong network of creatives in the space
  • Know how visuals can tap into emotion and psychology
  • Happy to jump in and help across the production process

Key Obsessions (What are you obsessed with?)

  • Obsessed with Visual Storytelling: Always thinking about how to tell a story visually — framing, pacing, movement, and how every shot contributes to the narrative.
  • Obsessed with Viewer Engagement: Constantly asking: “Will this keep the viewer watching?” They look at retention graphs, know how to build hooks, and design moments that emotionally land.
  • Obsessed with Efficiency: Loves building systems that speed things up. They design animatics that are clear, production-ready, and save the animators hours of guesswork.
  • Obsessed with Detail, Without Getting Slowed Down: They notice when a transition doesn’t feel right or a shot lacks emotional punch — but they also know how to move fast and not get stuck.

Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities. We are an AI technology solutions provider for technology companies and sectors including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies with a global workforce of subject matter experts and a secure infrastructure, we support AI development and applications across healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health, and biomedical research.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, focusing on microbiological sciences. You will evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology.

Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

title: Account Manager - HOMES/HEAR Program
description:
Overview

APTIM's Energy Transition is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager . This position is based in Minnesota and serves as a primary conduit to the market providing education and collaboration to stakeholders on behalf of the HOMES/HEAR program. APTIM's role is to develop and manage Home Energy Rebates created through the Inflation Reduction Act including the Home Efficiency Rebate Program (HOMES) and the Home Electrification and Appliance Rebate Program (HEAR). The Sr. Account Manager will be responsible for networking with customers and stakeholders to drive program performance and goal attainment. Residential program knowledge and technical expertise in energy efficiency and electrification is required. This role will report to the Program Manager.

APTIM's Energy Transition team is a recognized leader in the marketplace. Our technical experts deliver highly innovative projects and complex client solutions providing the full breadth of energy solutions including energy management, carbon management, smart energy infrastructure, distributed energy resources (DER), and carbon-free mobility solutions. Our consultants proactively collaborate with clients to define and implement strategies and campaigns around key business drivers, with the primary focus of finding and delivering high-impact projects exceeding expectations and meeting the unique needs for our clients.

The successful candidate will immediately assume an active role supporting the planning and operational activities for the programs. The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for utilizing existing community partners and building a network of stakeholders and customers targeting energy efficiency projects that align with the HOMES/HEAR program. The Sr. Account Manager will be expected to engage with organizations proactively to understand their unique goals and challenges and communicate how the HOMES/HEAR programs can support those goals and challenges. This position will be a critical member of the team by informing overarching strategic direction and driving new initiatives and energy savings.

This position is based in Minnesota and will have frequent day travel within specific territories. There is the opportunity for travel outside of the area, sporadically, for conferences, events, and continuing education. The Sr. Account Manager must be a critical thinker, able to manage multiple tasks, have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to maintain positive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners. The role requires a person who is accountable, process driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic. Individuals in this role will be expected to embrace a collaborative approach, take ownership of their workspace, and find solutions to challenges as they arise and be highly flexible to adjust to program needs. In this role, you will be working with others who are passionate about clean energy, energy efficiency, and making a positive impact on the industry.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Work as part of an energy efficiency and electrification team ensuring the administration, implementation, and verification of federally funded energy efficiency projects are successfully executed.
  • Develop reporting that aligns with DOE requirements and provides operations leadership insights to improve operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing or potential organizations to produce qualified leads, layer services/rebates and/or improve the customer experience, driving project participation.
  • Connect regularly with organizations via phone, email, virtual platforms, and face-to-face discussions to ensure they are current on HOMES/HEAR offerings and efforts, and to gain the organizations perspective on issues relating to the programs.
  • Lead and project manage initiatives that drive toward improved customer experience and participation in programs.
  • Develop and lead presentations promoting HOMES/HEAR programs at various conferences, community events, or professional organizations.
  • Respond to direct inquiries and requests made by customers, organizations, and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Deliver supporting information, collateral, and contacts to partners to support deepened customer engagement.
  • Be attuned to broad regulator, policy, and economic concerns impacting programs and bring these perspectives to program leadership.
  • Perform field QAQC as needed within assigned territory.
  • Frequent day travel and occasional overnight (depending on conferences, training or other opportunities).
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Ensuring compliance with all APTIM quality and safety policies as well as all OSHA regulations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of industry experience required.
  • Knowledge of energy efficiency and electrification programs.
  • Experience working with any of the following stakeholders: businesses, contractors, utilities, CBOs, community leaders, retailers, program implementers, manufacturers or distributors of energy-efficient equipment or services.
  • Strong service orientation with the ability to work across multiple departments and units within an organization, external clients, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management, project management, and follow-through; creative problem solver with strong analytical abilities.
  • Ability to absorb information from multiple parties and formulate necessary communications or decisions quickly.
  • Conceptual understanding of energy efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, and the types of equipment, technologies, and building practices relevant to residential customers.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience in the use of typical productivity software tools.
  • Strong quantitative and analytic capabilities to interpret data and solve practical problems.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills.
  • Ability to travel within Minnesota regularly and occasionally out-of-state.
  • Must be a self-starter, organized and have an ability to manage competing priorities with established deadlines.
  • Commitment to fostering a collaborative work environment within the team and broader organization.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office software -- Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.

Desired/Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience working with a wide variety of stakeholders, such as state, local and federal governments, for-profit and non-profit organizations, utilities, multifamily properties and others.
  • CEM, BPI, QCI, PMP, or similar certification.
  • 3+ years' experience in the energy efficiency industry.

About APTIM

APTIM is committed to accelerating the transition toward a clean and efficient energy economy, building a sustainable future for our communities and natural world, and creating a more inclusive and equitable environment that celebrates the diversity of our communities. We specialize in environmental, resilience, and sustainability and energy solutions, as well as technical and data solutions, program management, and critical infrastructure. For every challenge our clients face, there is an opportunity for APTIM to innovate a fit-for-purpose solution that will raise your organization or community to a new standard of excellence.

What you can expect from APTIM:

  • Work that is worthy of your time and talent
  • Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
  • Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
  • A voice in making our company better
  • Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $90K-$140K. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

Employee Benefits

Aptim Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits Marketplace information is available internally.

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and 10+ carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs and engineers in 2016, Pismo is a technology company that provides a comprehensive processing platform for banking, card issuing and financial market infrastructure and helps customers innovate and build the next generation of banking and payment solutions. Pismo joined Visa in 2024.

Leveraging Visa’s solutions, our core platform, and an expanding suite of capabilities, Pismo addresses the technological challenges that large banks, marketplaces, and fintech companies face in migrating from legacy systems to more advanced technology in the market. Pismo’s cloud-based platform empowers firms to build and launch financial products rapidly, scaling as they grow to have a broader audience while keeping high security and availability standards.

Pismo’s 500+ employees are located in more than 10 countries around the world.

What you will do

  • Accounts squad is a core component of the ecosystem, storing and processing data for all accounts and customers. There is a high focus on reliability, high volume, and low latency.
  • Ensure systems are scalable and maintain data integrity
  • Apply staff engineering guidelines and standards to current systems
  • Support other engineers in implementations
  • Identify hidden flaws in existing systems
  • Collaborate on cross-squad implementations
  • Contribute to architectural design of complex systems
  • Understand multiple workstreams and provide effective technical support
  • Demonstrate strong product awareness in relevant business areas
  • Work closely with product leadership to align with product-market fit
  • Promote urgency around company priorities and step up to lead when needed
  • Propose engineering strategies within your discipline and drive alignment

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Be based in Brazil
  • English level B2
  • Experience with Golang
  • Cloud computing knowledge
  • Event-driven architecture familiarity
  • Understanding of distributed systems, including:
    • Distributed race conditions
    • Distributed transactions

Desirable:

  • Experience with Java
  • Experience with observability and metrics
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI
  • Load testing experience
  • Knowledge of Terraform
  • DevOps practices
  • Financial industry experience

Additional Information

Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: FX Trader - EMEA
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We seek an experienced and dynamic FX Sales Manager to drive business growth and manage relationships with key clients in the money remittance and financial services sectors. In this role, you will lead FX negotiations, collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions and ensure exceptional execution of cross-border payment transactions. You will leverage your expertise in FX markets to provide valuable insights to clients while consistently meeting sales targets and contributing to the organization’s overall success.

What will I be doing?

  • Drive negotiations with existing money remittance and financial services merchants, ensuring the achievement of sales targets while optimizing client value.
  • Build and maintain long-lasting relationships with clients by understanding their specific needs and delivering tailored FX solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Work closely with the internal Trader team to ensure alignment on market strategies, competitive pricing, and efficient execution of FX transactions.
  • Provide clients with actionable insights on FX market trends, movements, and forecasts, helping them stay informed and make sound decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of FX transactions, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and operational excellence.
  • Regularly conduct market analysis and research on industry trends and competitors to stay ahead of market developments and anticipate client needs.
  • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, ensuring transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What skills do I need?

  • Strong knowledge of local and international FX markets, including market dynamics, trading strategies, and regulatory environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets, with a track record of driving revenue growth and expanding business opportunities.
  • Exceptional business development, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with experience managing high-value client accounts.
  • In-depth understanding or experience with cross-border payment systems and their complexities, including risk management and cost optimization.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a logical problem-solving approach, helping identify opportunities and overcome challenges.
  • Highly self-motivated and goal-driven, with the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage , Linkedin , Instagram , and Youtube for more about dLocal!

  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

  • Email: ******

If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond.

title: Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

We are a leader in fraud prevention and AML compliance. Our platform uses device intelligence, behavior biometrics, machine learning, and AI to stop fraud before it happens. Today, over 300 banks, retailers, and fintechs worldwide use Sardine to stop identity fraud, payment fraud, account takeovers, and social engineering scams. We have raised $145M from world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Activant, Visa, Experian, FIS, and Google Ventures.

Our Culture

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn\'t have to miss your family dinner, your kid\'s school play, friends get-together, or doctor\'s appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location: Remote - Brazil

To be considered for this position, you must reside in one of the following cities:

  • São Paulo: São Paulo, Campinas, São José dos Campos
  • Rio de Janeiro: Rio de Janeiro
  • Minas Gerais: Belo Horizonte
  • Paraná: Curitiba
  • Santa Catarina: Florianópolis

About The Role

We\'re a growing company looking for a Product Designer to join our team and help us design a user-centric SaaS dashboard to prevent fraud.

This isn\'t just about pixels; it\'s about problem-solving. You\'ll work closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to understand complex challenges and create intuitive and comprehensive experiences for our users. We have a complex product; you will need to make it easy.

As a fast-growing start-up, you will need to independently explore the context, talk to different stakeholders, understand the problem end-to-end, and propose solutions that make sense with our product.

Requests usually come with just the tip of the iceberg. You will need to get into the bushes. This role is not for a Product Designer that expects a complete brief, a list of detailed tasks, and endless calls. We move fast. You need to be fast. And good.

What You\'ll Do

  • Proactively drive the entire design process, from independently identifying user problems and exploring solutions through research and validation, to final implementation and hand-off.
  • Go beyond the \"happy path\" by designing for all user flows, edge cases, and UI states to ensure a smooth hand-off to engineering.
  • We are remote, you need to show visibility, communicate status, and progress reports with your team. Comment, annotate, and tag teammates in all your files. Work closely with product managers and engineers.

What You\'ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience (or strong portfolio) designing UI and UX for dashboards and SaaS products.
  • Master Figma, with expertise in Auto Layout, Components, Variants, and Prototypes
  • Master Design Systems and their application to create and scale a consistent dashboard experience
  • User-centered design principles with a strong understanding of data visualization best practices
  • Experience communicating with leadership. You will communicate ideas and ping pong requirements with the CEO, CTO, and CPO levels.
  • Be aware of the future state of design. AI is changing the game. We are already exploring new design workflows.
  • Startup / Small Company / Founder Experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in globally distributed teams
  • If you\'ve worked in Fraud, AML, Compliance, Payments, Fintech, Banking, that\'s a plus
  • Played around with Figma Make, Gemini, Loveable, v0, or similar? Sweet!
  • A little front-end code familiarity will make your job easier

Compensation

Base pay range of R$265,000- R$370,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

The compensation offered for this role will depend on various factors, including the candidate\'s location, qualifications, work history, and interview performance, and may differ from the stated range.

Benefits We Offer

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity
  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested
  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture
  • Flexible paid time off, Year-end break, Self care days off
  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific
  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific
  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door
  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.
  • Monthly meal stipend
  • Monthly social meet-up stipend
  • Annual health and wellness stipend
  • Annual Learning stipend
  • Unlimited access to an expert financial advisory

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

IWG – Partnership Sales Lead

Are you ready to lead the charge and be at the forefront of our ambitious global expansion? Is hunting, pitching and prospecting second nature to you? Can you confidently agree high-value commercial deals with building owners? Is business development in your blood? And are you relentless in your pursuit of delivering results, with the determination and resilience to change the world of work?

You’re reading the right ad if you’re looking for:

  • The most exciting growth opportunity in the world, where you’ll be challenged every day

About IWG

IWG is the world’s leading flexible workspace provider – with the world’s most ambitious growth programme to open 30,000+ new centres over the next decade to complement our international network of 4,000+ tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring flexible work centres. Across our multiple brands, including Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, we’re provide world-beating workplace solutions to over 80% of Fortune 500 companies, including Netflix, EY, Amazon and Uber, as well as to local small start-ups, entrepreneurs and emerging businesses.

About you

You’ll need to be passionate about working in a high-growth sector and ready to play a leading role in disrupting the commercial real-estate industry. You’ll excel at growing your network rapidly and taking our proposition to them. And you’ll thrive on initiating and closing multiple high-value deals at pace driven by your tenacity and expertise.

Whether pursuing your own leads or following up on centrally-driven enquiries, you’ll highlight what makes an IWG partnership so special. By ensuring prospective partners fully understand the value of our proposition, you’ll be doing much more than simply meeting sales targets. And thanks to your outstanding communications skills – primarily in your local language but also with a good level of English – you’ll be able to present a truly compelling narrative to large and small audiences alike.

Most importantly though, you’ll have the right, can-do mindset: passion, curiosity, pride, drive and ownership. We’ll look after the rest.

What you’ll be doing

Join our team of over 200 Partnerships Sales Leaders and you’ll get to harness your entrepreneurial mindset, strong business and financial acumen, and commitment to achieving outstanding business development results as we add to the over 1,000 deals in 50+ countries closed in the past year alone.

From one day to the next, you’ll get the chance to:

  • Employ a dynamic and versatile approach to business development, tailoring it to our partners’ varying commercial needs and requirements
  • Actively manage your pipeline of opportunities to drive each opportunity from initial contact, through detailed commercial negotiations, all the way to a signed commercial agreement.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose is to help everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet. We are proud to supply all our customers with carbon-neutral workplaces, and have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award

IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023 and 2024. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

This role joins the Financial Solutions (Partners at Scale) team that is responsible for leading the credit department, with a primary focus on B2B operations. As the lead for the credit department, you'll be responsible for building and scaling the credit function from scratch. This is a hands-on role where you will define and implement credit policies and procedures, ensuring the financial health of business partnerships. The position involves conducting structured credit analyses for large clients, assessing financial statements and operational data to determine risk, and presenting cases to credit committees.

What We Offer You

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Analista Governança e Controle Pleno – Globo – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Overview

Analista Governança e Controle Pleno – Globo – Rio de Janeiro

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança.

Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG.

Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos.

O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

Como atendimento em Projetos

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.
  • Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências.
  • Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.

No ciclo orçamentário de projetos

  • Levant a e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.
  • Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos.

No ciclo de gestão de OKRs

  • Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle.
  • Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização.
  • Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais.

No apoio à medição e melhoria de processos e tarefas

  • Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para corrections de rumo.
  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.

No apoio à gestão

  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado);
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário);
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi);
  • Automação de processos. Ex: VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365;
  • Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO;
  • Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera;
  • Programação no Power BI;
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

About the Role

  • Own It We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Never Stop Learning We cultivate a culture where it’s safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.

Bonus Points

Why Join Us

At Tinder, we believe in creating meaningful connections, not only for our members but also within our team. You’ll be part of a passionate, creative, and collaborative LATAM marketing squad, helping shape how Tinder shows up in Brazilst

Who We Are

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for MSPs, SMBs, enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect and belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. We seek individuals who excel in dynamic, global environments and have a never give up attitude, contributing to our collective growth and impact.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities/communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals/targets.

This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.

title: Revenue Manager - Remote
description:
Compensation TypeYearly Highgate Hotels

Highgate is a premier real estate investment and hospitality management company widely recognized as an innovator in the industry. Highgate is the dominant player in U.S. gateway markets including New York, Boston, Miami, San Francisco and Honolulu, with a rapidly expanding presence in Europe, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Highgate’s portfolio of global properties represents an aggregate asset value exceeding $20B and generates over $5B in cumulative revenues. The company provides expert guidance through all stages of the hospitality property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate also has the creativity and bandwidth to develop bespoke hotel brands and utilizes industry-leading proprietary revenue management tools that identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive out performance and maximize asset value. With an executive team consisting of some of the industry’s most experienced hotel management leaders, the company is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. Highgate maintains corporate offices in London, New York, Dallas, and Seattle.

Location Overview

The Revenue Manager is responsible for identifying and maximizing all potential revenue opportunities for the hotel. In today’s lodging environment, understanding channel and yield management is critical for maximizing revenues.The Revenue Manager is responsible for formulating long and short-term Revenue Management strategies and for overseeing their successful execution towards the advancement of RevPAR market share.This includes the analysis of revenue potential generated by the transient and group market segments as well as the market segmentation within transient and group. One will combine this with catering and space utilization as well as other revenue considerations (i.e.: golf, spa, etc.) in order to determine the appropriate mix of business to achieve revenue potentials every day of every year.

Responsibilities
  • Establish hotel pricing levels in all segments.
  • Responsible for the daily room inventory management process and daily pricing process.
  • Monitor competitor rates, positioning, strategies and data; maintain understanding of the dynamics of the local market and demand generators and present appropriate action plans to management.
  • Monitor and communicate fluctuations in occupancy to operational departments so they can effectively manage staffing requirements and increase efficiency.
  • Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.
  • Understand the macro and micro-economic variables affecting supply and demand in the local marketplace, and use this knowledge to create accurate operational and financial room revenue forecasts.
  • Perform unconstrained demand analysis to determine optimal business mix.
  • Responsible for all short and long term forecasts including Weekly Forecasts, Forecasts, In the month forecasts, and Full year forecasts.
  • Oversee process for evaluating all opportunities for contracted business (group, wholesale, corporate negotiated, etc.) presented through the Sales department. Ensure that process enables high speed of response while maximizing profits.
  • Responsible for the maintenance of any software programs which contribute to the management of rooms revenue, including the CRS, RMS, PMS and Sales & Catering system.
  • Monitor RevPAR index on STR report and provide critical analysis of performance on weekly and monthly basis.
  • Prepare annual Rooms revenue budget.
  • Chair weekly Revenue Strategy meetings in order to formulate and disseminate strategies and tactics. Ensure that prior decisions are re-visited in this forum in order to evaluate their effectiveness and promote learning.
  • Prepare and present quarterly presentations to ownership.
  • Ensure all distribution channels have correct content and pricing.
  • Develop and maintain a close relationship with the market manager of Third Party Intermediaries to maximize the opportunities with these channels.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with other market revenue managers and Directors of Revenue to create a network of peers in your community
  • Coordinate survey activities involving marketing and service opportunities to further enhance revenue potential.
  • Actively develop all subordinates, ensuring that they have opportunities to grow their Revenue Management and leadership skill base through personal attention, internal/external training and participation in industry events.
  • Responsible for Internet Marketing such as pay per click campaigns, e-mail blasts, GDS advertising, etc.
  • Establish and communicate sales strategy for day, week, month and rolling 12 months.
  • Communicate any strategy changes or update any calendars for the sales team to use.
  • Analyze prior night successes: Did the hotel sell out? Were the right decisions made for overselling? Address the opportunities in Highgate Hotel Business Review (HHBR) morning meeting.
  • Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.
  • Manage and communicate group cut off dates. Run a group rooms control log (GRC) as well as pick up report from Property Management System (PMS) for 90 days. Verify pick up to actual block, cut off date, and whether or not you should extend, etc.
  • Update the Daily Market Segment Analysis (DMSA). Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report. Review actual performance versus Potential performance.
  • Complete all required month end reports with detailed analysis. If necessary, complete action plans for the property to follow to create additional production/revenue.
  • Review Hotelligence reports for trends, booking windows and sources of business as well as rates compared to competition.
Qualifications
  • At least 2 years experience in the Revenue Management field as manager or senior analyst

Por isso, priorizamos o crescimento e desenvolvimento de quem faz esse propósito acontecer todos os dias: nossas pessoas! Na Auvo, você vai encontrar uma equipe incrível, composta por pessoas muito talentosas que sempre buscam melhorar constantemente seu desempenho. Buscamos alguém com visão de negócio, domínio analítico, capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica e que enxergue o marketing de produto como um vetor de crescimento. Você terá protagonismo para conectar as entregas do time de produto aos reais problemas dos nossos clientes, transformando soluções técnicas em diferenciais percebidos, com impacto direto em aquisição, engajamento e retenção.
